description: Redux reducer module managing group-related state slices such as syncables, groups, stats, and user groups in the Mattermost application.

methods.name: syncables
methods.description: Reducer handling synchronization state of group teams and channels, including updates, linking, and unlinking.

methods.name: myGroups
methods.description: Reducer managing the list of group IDs that the current user belongs to.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Reducer managing statistical data related to groups.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Reducer managing the main collection of group objects, including creation, updates, and associations.
